# Metacognitive Therapy Central

> Evidence-based mental health treatment platform offering MCT therapy, professional supervision, and clinical resources for anxiety, OCD, and overthinking disorders.

Metacognitive Therapy Central provides specialized MCT services aligned with MCT Institute standards, serving both clients seeking therapy and mental health professionals pursuing supervision and training. The organization offers evidence-based treatment, clinical supervision, educational resources, and research participation opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Metacognitive Therapy (MCT)
- Cognitive Attentional Syndrome (CAS)
- Anxiety treatment
- OCD and intrusive thoughts
- Overthinking treatment
- Attention Training Technique
- Detached mindfulness
- Professional supervision
- Evidence-based treatment
- Therapy exercises
- MCT Institute standards
- CBT comparison
- Mental health services
- Clinical training
- Worry postponement

## Core Services

- [Get Therapy](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/get-therapy): Main therapy service offering MCT for overthinking and anxiety treatment
- [Get Supervision](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/get-supervision): Professional MCT supervision and therapist training service with case consultation
- [Services Overview](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/services): Overview of therapy, supervision, and mental health support services

## MCT Education & Guides

- [What is Metacognitive Therapy? Everything You Need to Know](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/what-is-metacognitive-therapy-everything-you-need-to-know): Comprehensive beginner's guide to MCT concepts and CAS framework
- [Metacognitive Therapy Exercises: How to Use Them Successfully](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/metacognitive-therapy-exercises-how-to-use-them-successfully): Guide to MCT exercises including worry postponement and attention training
- [MCT Articles](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/mct-articles): Collection of MCT articles on anxiety, OCD, and therapy techniques
- [MCT Articles - Therapy Techniques](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/mct-article): MCT articles on therapy techniques, anxiety, and intrusive thought management

## Research & Analysis

- [Metacognitive Therapy Does Not Work? Critique of Strengths and Weaknesses](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/metacognitive-therapy-does-not-work-a-critique-of-its-strengths-and-weaknesses): Critical analysis of MCT effectiveness compared to CBT and other therapies
- [Participate in Research](https://metacognitivetherapycentral.com/research): Research participation opportunities in MCT studies and clinical trials
